liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Music Never Stopped** (3 reviews): The performance is characterized by immense power and glory; Listener calls this the best version heard, praising the energetic solo [8][10][16]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Band starts crushing it in Est>Eyes, with a nice loop back into Playin; Effortless segue into Eyes with a monster intro and special notes [12][14]
- **Cold Rain & Snow** (1 review): Listener's favorite Dead opener, with this version being great [19]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Garcia's solo is described as a textbook performance with every note perfect [8]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Jerry's attacks are cosmic, transitioning seamlessly into a mellow Eyes groove [11]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): First leg dissolves into Jerry improvising with minimal backup from the band [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-02-03.164050.aud.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 171 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1978-02-03.164048.akg.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 171 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd78-02-03.aud.warner.19465.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 4.28/5 by 25 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience tape has mechanical issues, including a cut row Jimmy section [12]
- **gd1978-02-03.164049.akg.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 171 min [3]

## Around the show

- Crisp February weather in Madison, Wisconsin [8]
- Listener was in a pitiful space after a breakup, feeling the show was for them [17]
- Jerry brought the crowd up, playing with them and getting off on each other [18]
- Lacks the passion present in the January 22, 1978 performance [15]
- Not quite as sonorous as the July 8, 1978 performance [15]
- More upbeat than the July 8, 1978 Red Rocks show [16]
- Parts of the show sound like 1973, distinct from the early 80s era [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-02-03.164050.aud.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes (unknown equipment) > PCM > Tim McKenzie's DAT (16/44.1) [1]
- **gd1978-02-03.164048.akg.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Tim McKenzie; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; AKG mics > unknown deck > 1st generation cassettes > Tim McKenzie's 2nd generation cassettes [2]
- **gd78-02-03.aud.warner.19465.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [5]. Also: Master audience cassette (unknown equipment) to PCM, DAT, CD, then extracted and encoded [5]
- **gd1978-02-03.164049.akg.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Tim McKenzie; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; AKG mics > unknown deck > 1st generation cassettes > Tim McKenzie's 2nd generation cassettes [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gdnotebook.blogspot.com: [1973-10-25 - Dane County Coliseum](https://gdnotebook.blogspot.com/2010/11/1973-10-25-dane-county-coliseum.html) [21]
- Fan art by recordsale.de: [Dick's Picks, Vol. 18: Dane County Coliseum - 2/3/78; Uni-Dome, University Of N. Iowa - 2/5/ - The Grateful Dead | Recor](https://recordsale.de/en/artists/the-grateful-dead/albums/dick-s-picks-vol-18-dane-county-coliseum-2-3-78-uni-dome-university-of-n-iowa-2-5) [22]
